title: Moosonee and the Polar Bear Express
subtitle: A snowy drive north, a train through frozen country and winter streets beside the Moose River.

chapters.title: On the Polar Bear Express
paragraphs: The train passes snowy forest, frozen waterways and small buildings beside the line. Inside are carriage seats, a café counter and views through the windows.

chapters.title: Moosonee and the river
paragraphs: Blue train carriages give way to snowy streets and the frozen river. The walk passes snowmobiles, houses, community buildings and the ice road.

chapters.title: Back to Cochrane
paragraphs: The return begins beside the train at blue hour. After dinner on board, the last photographs are station lights, an engine, an illuminated polar bear and holiday decorations.
